prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity desktop web application direction comp, 1440x1000 landscape
Primary request: Design a conventional but exceptionally polished executive dashboard for a Thai university planning, budget, project, quarterly disbursement, and KPI management system.
Composition/framing: familiar fixed light sidebar with labeled navigation; top header with fiscal year and quarter filters; one row of compact KPI summary cards; below, one labeled budget-versus-disbursement chart, one project status breakdown, one KPI progress panel, then an action-required table. Include an inspector drawer only if it fits cleanly.
Style/medium: production-ready modern admin SaaS UI; flat clean grid; disciplined spacing; crisp Thai typography; conventional information architecture executed with excellent craft.
Color palette: white #FFFFFF, warm gray #F5F5F4, vivid orange #EA580C, deep orange #C2410C, charcoal #1C1917, status green amber and red.
Text (verbatim where legible): ระบบบริหารแผน, ภาพรวมผู้บริหาร, ข้อมูลตัวอย่าง, ปีงบประมาณ 2570, ไตรมาส 1, งบประมาณ, ผลเบิกจ่าย, สถานะโครงการ, KPI EdPEx & AUN-QA, รายการที่ต้องดำเนินการ.
Constraints: Thai-first; accessible contrast; tabular numerals; clear status labels; no logo invention; no browser chrome; realistic university administrative sample data.
Avoid: gradients, glassmorphism, huge rounded cards, purple/blue brand accents, decorative illustration, excessive pills, dark mode, empty whitespace, unlabeled charts.
